turnaround.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 3D modeling turnaround reference sheet. Input image: definitive character identity reference. Create one wide four-panel model sheet of THIS EXACT alpaca-bird alebrije, showing front, left profile, right profile, and rear. Full body in each panel at identical scale, feet on same baseline, orthographic camera, neutral cream background, no labels or text. Preserve long graceful cream alpaca neck, kind expressive brown eyes, short rounded alpaca muzzle, tall pointed ears, orange/red/teal cockatiel crest, plump horizontal wool body, exactly two long slender ostrich legs and clawed bird feet, two broad feather wings raised and spread, short fanned colorful feather tail. Preserve matte hand-painted wooden sculpture/gouache texture, orange marigold flowers, teal leafy stems, red geometric bands, cream dots. All four views show the same anatomy, same wing root placement at upper sides of torso, same pose, same proportions. Wings have real thickness and individually layered feathers; do not add arms, quadruped legs, horns, clothing, or change species. Infer unseen back markings consistently from reference. This is a precise turnaround of the supplied character, not a redesign.

body.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square base-color texture for UV mapping onto a 3D hand-painted alebrije sculpture. Warm ivory not white; burnt orange, muted teal, brick red and golden ochre.
